definition.simple: A pause in trading a share. While it lasts, you cannot buy or sell it at all.
definition.balanced: An exchange or regulator may halt a share pending news, after a very sharp price move, or when there are questions about the company's information. A halt can last minutes or much longer. When trading restarts, the price can open far from where it stopped, so a [[stop-loss]] gives no protection during the pause.
